title: console(home): fold the roster gate's by-name object reads into one ?names= request (#29236 ruling A follow-up)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: ruling A on #29236 (6580261740), the workload's `domain:ui` follow-up. Blocked-by #29236 (the server PR) and #29441 (spec).

After #29121, Console Home reads each object the app roster requires by name, one request per name (8 on app-crm). Once `GET /meta/:type?names=a,b,c` ships, the roster gate makes one request for its `requiresObject` union. Remember that an unknown name is simply absent from the answer, so the gate must treat a missing item as it treats a 404 today.

Acceptance: Home outside an app makes one object metadata request for the roster gate, measured on app-crm.
